ModMetadata.Name: Faster Frame Finishing
ModMetadata.Author: Faster Frame Finishing contributors
ModMetadata.ChangeLog: 1.2.0 - Welding iron and steel sheets onto frames is now faster too, at the same speed setting as the plastic finishing step. Placing frames and taking them apart are unchanged. "Instant Finish" is now "Instant Mode" and covers welding as well.
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Faster Frame Finishing[/h1] Speeds up welding sheets onto iron and steel frames, and the plastic-sheet finish on steel frames. The default is 5x faster.
[table] [tr][th]Step[/th][th]Normal[/th][th]With the mod (5x)[/th][/tr] [tr][td]Weld iron or steel sheet (two per frame)[/td][td]1.0 s each[/td][td]0.2 s each[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Plastic finish (steel frames)[/td][td]2.0 s[/td][td]0.4 s[/td][/tr] [/table]
[h2]Features[/h2] [list] [*]Works on iron and steel frames [*]Speed options: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x or 10x [*]Optional instant mode [*]Uses the same tools and materials as normal [*]Placing frames, taking frames apart and all other structures are unchanged [*]Nothing is stored in your save, so the mod can be added or removed at any time [*]Client-side: the server and other players do not need it [/list]
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*]BepInEx 5 [*][url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url] [/list]
[h2]How to install[/h2] [olist] [*]Install BepInEx and StationeersLaunchPad by following the [url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad#installation]StationeersLaunchPad installation guide[/url]. You only need to do this once. [*]Click [b]Subscribe[/b] on this page. [*]Start Stationeers. LaunchPad loads the mod automatically. [/olist] If the mod does not load, click the LaunchPad box on the loading screen and check that [b]Faster Frame Finishing[/b] is ticked.
[h2]Settings[/h2] Settings are in [b]main menu > Workshop > Faster Frame Finishing > Mod Configuration[/b], or in the LaunchPad window while the game is loading. Restart the game after changing a setting.
[table] [tr][th]Setting[/th][th]Default[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr] [tr][td]Enabled[/td][td]On[/td][td]Turns the mod on or off. Off means normal speed.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Speed Multiplier[/td][td]5x[/td][td]How much faster welding and finishing are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x or 10x.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Instant Mode[/td][td]Off[/td][td]Makes welding and finishing almost instant, whatever the speed setting.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Debug Logging[/td][td]Off[/td][td]Writes extra details to the log file, for bug reports.[/td][/tr] [/table]
[h2]Multiplayer[/h2] Each player who wants faster frame building installs the mod. The server does not need it, and players without it keep the normal speed. Materials are used and frames seal exactly as normal for everyone.
[h2]Game updates[/h2] If an update changes how frames are built, the mod leaves frames at normal speed until it is updated.
[h2]Uninstalling[/h2] Click [b]Unsubscribe[/b]. Saves are not affected.
[h2]Source code and bug reports[/h2] [url=https://github.com/macg4dave/faster_frame_finishing]Faster Frame Finishing on GitHub[/url]
